entities.title: The AI step: metadata into views
entities.summary: Turn what a scan collected into views the explorer draws, with Claude Haiku 5.5, reading only what changed.
entities.details: Built as src/ai.js and src/views.js. A website's sections are classified with the Festi scheme and written as a component diagram (zones and sections, the outside services their pages load), a deployment diagram (DNS, mail, loaded providers) and a folder record per section. A repository without views gets a component diagram of the parts the model proposed whose folders exist. Direct calls rather than the Batch API (decision direct-calls).
acceptanceCriteria: Views written under files/ validate against Meta/Agents/Skills.
An unchanged page is not sent again.
A refusal marks the item and the scan continues.

entities.title: Certificate Transparency and Common Crawl
entities.summary: Add the sources the Festi prototype used: hostnames from Certificate Transparency, and archived pages from Common Crawl for sites that refuse the crawler.
entities.details: The prototype read crt.sh and Common Crawl's index by byte-range binary search over its public files. Both work from a Worker; crt.sh is slow and needs a long timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: A site walled off to crawlers shows its last public interior, marked with the crawl it came from.

entities.title: The /crawler page
entities.summary: The address in the user agent: what the crawler is, how it behaves, how to keep it out and how to cooperate. Served by worker/markdown.js from the protocol document.
entities.details: Served by the explorer's Worker from docs/cyberspace-protocol.md.
acceptanceCriteria: https://cyberspace-explorer.com/crawler answers with the protocol and the crawler's manners.

entities.title: A monthly limit on the AI step's spending
entities.summary: Count the tokens each reading used and stop asking once a monthly budget set in /admin is spent.
entities.details: Each answer's usage is already returned by claudeAsker; nothing adds it up yet.
acceptanceCriteria: /admin shows the month's spend and the budget.
Over budget, scans continue and readings wait for the next month.
